issuances.author: Forecaster
issuances.synopsis: Ridging rebuilds tonight ahead of the next shortwave. Light showers linger over the Olympics into the evening.
issuances.extendedOutlook: Warm and dry Friday through the weekend, with freezing levels climbing toward 12,500 ft.

olympics.morning: Mostly cloudy with a few morning showers, clearing by afternoon. Light ridgetop winds.
olympics.afternoon: Sunny and warmer, with freezing levels rising through the day.

issuances.author: Forecaster
issuances.synopsis: A weak upper-level trough grazes the Cascades today, keeping a marine push alive west of the crest. Freezing levels stay near 11,000 ft.
